translateBank.en: The young travelers were out to explore every island on the map.

words.ex_en: It took the mountain-climbing group two days to trek across the rainforest.
words.ex_zh: 這個登山團隊花了兩天跋涉橫越這片雨林。
words.ex_blank: It took the mountain-climbing group two days to ____ across the rainforest.
words.ex2_en: We're planning to trek through Southeast Asia for three months.
words.ex2_zh: 我們計畫花三個月的時間在東南亞徒步旅行。
words.ex2_blank: We're planning to ____ through Southeast Asia for three months.
words.ex3_en: Eddie encountered a rattlesnake when he was trekking through the desert.
words.ex3_zh: 艾迪在穿越沙漠長途跋涉時遇到響尾蛇。
words.ex3_blank: Eddie encountered a rattlesnake when he was ____ through the desert.
words.grammar: trek 是規則動詞，但字尾要重複子音字母再加 -ed/-ing：trek → trekked → trekking。

translateBank.zh: 每年冬天都有數千名登山客長途跋涉穿越這個山谷。
translateBank.en: Every winter, thousands of hikers trek through this valley.

translateBank.zh: 她明年想徒步橫越喜馬拉雅山。
translateBank.en: She wants to trek across the Himalayas next year.

translateBank.zh: 很少有遊客會長途跋涉深入這片叢林。
translateBank.en: Few tourists trek this far into the jungle.

translateBank.zh: 我哥哥每年夏天都會去不同的山長途健行。
translateBank.en: My brother treks to a different mountain every summer.

translateBank.zh: 我們計畫沿著海岸步道跋涉五天。
translateBank.en: We plan to trek along the coastal trail for five days.

translateBank.zh: 大多數背包客會在日出前長途跋涉抵達山頂。
translateBank.en: Most backpackers trek to the summit before sunrise.

translateBank.zh: 他每次到新的國家都喜歡自己一個人長途跋涉。
translateBank.en: He treks alone whenever he visits a new country.

translateBank.zh: 他們決定長途跋涉前往村莊，而不是搭巴士。
translateBank.en: They decided to trek instead of taking the bus to the village.

translateBank.zh: 這家公司提供協助，讓遊客能安全地長途跋涉穿越雨林。
translateBank.en: This company offers to help tourists trek through the rainforest safely.

translateBank.zh: 有經驗的旅人不需要嚮導也能長途跋涉。
translateBank.en: Experienced travelers trek without needing a guide.

words.ex_en: The hot spring was quite relaxing and washed away Sam's troubles.
words.ex_zh: 這溫泉令人相當放鬆，也把山姆的煩惱洗滌一空。
words.ex_blank: The hot spring was quite ____ and washed away Sam's troubles.
words.ex2_en: Balance your hard traveling with stays at relaxing beaches.
words.ex2_zh: 用悠閒放鬆的海灘假期，來平衡辛苦的旅程。
words.ex2_blank: Balance your hard traveling with stays at ____ beaches.
words.ex3_en: By contrast, living in the country is quite relaxing.
words.ex3_zh: 相比之下，生活在鄉下頗輕鬆的。
words.ex3_blank: By contrast, living in the country is quite ____.
words.grammar: relaxing 形容「讓人感到放鬆的事物」；relaxed 是形容「人本身處於放鬆的狀態」，兩者容易搞混，要注意分辨。

translateBank.zh: 長途健行之後，這家溫泉度假村讓人感到非常放鬆。
translateBank.en: The hot spring resort was incredibly relaxing after a long hike.

translateBank.zh: 我們在泳池邊度過了一個悠閒放鬆的午後。
translateBank.en: We spent a relaxing afternoon reading by the pool.

translateBank.zh: 這座海邊小鎮提供了逃離都市生活的輕鬆去處。
translateBank.en: The beach town offers a relaxing escape from city life.

translateBank.zh: 我們青年旅館的花園是個寫明信片的安靜放鬆角落。
translateBank.en: Our hostel's garden is a quiet, relaxing place to write postcards.

translateBank.zh: 一趟輕鬆的河上船遊為我們的旅程畫下完美的結尾。
translateBank.en: A relaxing boat ride along the river ended our trip perfectly.

translateBank.zh: 我覺得穿越鄉間的長途火車之旅相當令人放鬆。
translateBank.en: I find long train rides through the countryside quite relaxing.

translateBank.zh: 這家度假村的水療療程讓人徹底放鬆。
translateBank.en: The spa treatment at the resort was deeply relaxing.

translateBank.zh: 從頂樓酒吧看夕陽讓人感覺超級放鬆。
translateBank.en: Watching the sunset from the rooftop bar felt so relaxing.

translateBank.zh: 他們選擇悠閒的島嶼假期，而不是忙碌的城市觀光。
translateBank.en: They chose a relaxing island getaway instead of a busy city tour.

translateBank.zh: 這場瑜珈靜修活動保證讓我們遠離手機，度過輕鬆的一週。
translateBank.en: The yoga retreat promised a relaxing week away from our phones.

words.ex_en: We made our way to the west coast from Chicago.
words.ex_zh: 我們從芝加哥一路前往西岸。
words.ex_blank: We ____ the west coast from Chicago.
words.ex2_en: After Hong Kong, we'll make our way to Thailand and Vietnam.
words.ex2_zh: 去完香港之後，我們會前往泰國和越南。
words.ex2_blank: After Hong Kong, we'll ____ Thailand and Vietnam.
words.ex3_en: It took her hours to make her way to the airport in heavy traffic.
words.ex3_zh: 在嚴重的塞車中，她花了好幾個小時才到達機場。
words.ex3_blank: It took her hours to ____ the airport in heavy traffic.
words.grammar: one's 要換成跟主詞一致的所有格（my/your/his/her/our/their），例如 made our way to、make her way to。

translateBank.zh: 我們在日出前一路趕到了渡輪碼頭。
translateBank.en: We made our way to the ferry terminal before sunrise.

translateBank.zh: 他穿過狹窄的巷子，一路前往青年旅館。
translateBank.en: He made his way to the hostel through narrow alleys.

translateBank.zh: 她降落後，一路前往簽證櫃檯。
translateBank.en: She made her way to the visa booth after landing.

translateBank.zh: 他們步行一路前往夜市。
translateBank.en: They made their way to the night market on foot.

translateBank.zh: 我及時趕到了報到櫃檯。
translateBank.en: I made my way to the check-in counter just in time.

translateBank.zh: 你應該在登機截止前趕到12號登機門。
translateBank.en: You should make your way to gate 12 before boarding closes.

translateBank.zh: 這群登山客在中午前一路抵達了山頂。
translateBank.en: The hikers made their way to the summit by noon.

translateBank.zh: 公車故障後，我們只好步行前往那個村莊。
translateBank.en: After the bus broke down, we made our way to the village on foot.

translateBank.zh: 她計畫去完泰國之後，再前往越南。
translateBank.en: She plans to make her way to Vietnam after Thailand.

translateBank.zh: 雨停之後他就會前往火車站。
translateBank.en: He'll make his way to the train station once the rain stops.

words.ex_en: Even though Nick is retired, he always tries to stay active.
words.ex_zh: 儘管尼克已退休了，但他總是保持活躍。
words.ex_blank: ____ Nick is retired, he always tries to stay active.
words.ex2_en: Even though we are traveling around the world, we'll have to pick and choose based on budget.
words.ex2_zh: 雖然我們是要環遊世界，但我們還是得依預算來挑選地點。
words.ex2_blank: ____ we are traveling around the world, we'll have to pick and choose based on budget.
words.ex3_en: Even though it was raining, hundreds of tourists still visited the temple.
words.ex3_zh: 儘管當時正在下雨，還是有數百名遊客造訪了這座寺廟。
words.ex3_blank: ____ it was raining, hundreds of tourists still visited the temple.
words.grammar: even though 後面要接完整子句（主詞+動詞），語氣比 though 強；不要跟表示假設的 even if 搞混。

translateBank.zh: 儘管班機延誤了，我們還是趕上了轉機。
translateBank.en: Even though the flight was delayed, we still made our connection.

translateBank.zh: 儘管票價較貴，她還是選擇了直飛班機。
translateBank.en: Even though it was expensive, she chose the direct flight.

translateBank.zh: 儘管他已經很累了，還是一直健行到天黑。
translateBank.en: Even though he was tired, he kept hiking until dark.

translateBank.zh: 儘管這家青年旅館已經滿房，他們還是幫我們找到了床位。
translateBank.en: Even though the hostel was fully booked, they found us a bed.

translateBank.zh: 儘管天氣不好，渡輪還是準時出發了。
translateBank.en: Even though the weather was bad, the ferry still left on time.

translateBank.zh: 儘管他們不會說當地語言，還是設法點了餐。
translateBank.en: Even though they couldn't speak the language, they managed to order food.

translateBank.zh: 儘管這段跋涉很辛苦，沿途的風景讓一切都值得了。
translateBank.en: Even though the trek was tough, the view made it worth it.

translateBank.zh: 儘管我們錯過了那班公車，還是在中午前到達了。
translateBank.en: Even though we missed the bus, we still arrived before noon.

translateBank.zh: 儘管簽證申請花了好幾週，她最後還是通過了。
translateBank.en: Even though the visa process took weeks, she finally got approved.

translateBank.zh: 儘管房間很小，這家膠囊旅館卻意外地舒適。
translateBank.en: Even though the room was small, the capsule hotel was surprisingly comfortable.

words.ex_en: Backpackers often choose to stay in a hostel to save money.
words.ex_zh: 背包客通常會選擇住青年旅館以省錢。
words.ex_blank: Backpackers often choose to stay in a ____ to save money.

translateBank.zh: 我們在火車站附近訂了一家便宜青年旅館的床位。
translateBank.en: We booked a bed at a cheap hostel near the train station.

translateBank.zh: 這家青年旅館有個共用廚房，旅客可以一起下廚。
translateBank.en: The hostel had a shared kitchen where travelers cooked together.

translateBank.zh: 大部分的青年旅館都提供免費早餐和無線網路。
translateBank.en: Most hostels offer free breakfast and Wi-Fi.

translateBank.zh: 她在青年旅館的公共休息室認識了另外三個背包客。
translateBank.en: She met three other backpackers at the hostel common room.

translateBank.zh: 這家青年旅館一晚只要八美元。
translateBank.en: This hostel only costs eight dollars a night.

translateBank.zh: 青年旅館的員工給了我們一張舊城區地圖。
translateBank.en: The hostel staff gave us a map of the old town.

translateBank.zh: 這座城市裡很多青年旅館都在步行可到海邊的距離內。
translateBank.en: Many hostels in this city are within walking distance of the beach.

translateBank.zh: 我們把行李放在青年旅館後就出門探險了。
translateBank.en: We left our bags at the hostel and went exploring.

translateBank.zh: 這家青年旅館的頂樓可以看到港口的美景。
translateBank.en: The rooftop of the hostel had a great view of the harbor.

translateBank.zh: 一個人旅行時，我比較喜歡住青年旅館而不是飯店。
translateBank.en: I prefer staying at a hostel instead of a hotel when traveling alone.

words.ex_en: A capsule hotel gives you just enough space to sleep in a small pod.
words.ex_zh: 膠囊旅館只提供一個小艙位，剛好夠你睡覺的空間。
words.ex_blank: A ____ gives you just enough space to sleep in a small pod.

translateBank.zh: 我們在東京第一次嘗試睡膠囊旅館。
translateBank.en: We tried sleeping in a capsule hotel for the first time in Tokyo.

translateBank.zh: 膠囊旅館對單獨旅行的人來說是便宜的選擇。
translateBank.en: A capsule hotel is a cheap option for solo travelers.

translateBank.zh: 車站附近那家膠囊旅館的艙位很小但很乾淨。
translateBank.en: The capsule hotel near the station had tiny but clean pods.

translateBank.zh: 有些膠囊旅館會提供置物櫃放行李。
translateBank.en: Some capsule hotels offer lockers for your luggage.

translateBank.zh: 他說那家膠囊旅館意外地讓人覺得舒適。
translateBank.en: He said the capsule hotel felt surprisingly comfortable.

translateBank.zh: 這家膠囊旅館一晚只收二十美元。
translateBank.en: This capsule hotel charges only twenty dollars a night.

translateBank.zh: 我很好奇住膠囊旅館會是什麼感覺。
translateBank.en: I was curious what staying in a capsule hotel would feel like.

translateBank.zh: 這家膠囊旅館的大廳看起來更像一座太空船。
translateBank.en: The capsule hotel's lobby looked more like a spaceship.

translateBank.zh: 商務旅客常常選擇膠囊旅館做短暫的過夜住宿。
translateBank.en: Business travelers often choose a capsule hotel for a quick overnight stay.

translateBank.zh: 我們的旅遊指南推薦了一家離機場很近的膠囊旅館。
translateBank.en: Our guidebook recommended a capsule hotel close to the airport.

words.ex_en: She did a workaway on a farm in exchange for free meals and a bed.
words.ex_zh: 她在一個農場打工換宿，換取免費三餐和住宿。
words.ex_blank: She did a ____ on a farm in exchange for free meals and a bed.

translateBank.zh: 她在紐西蘭一座有機農場找到了打工換宿的機會。
translateBank.en: She found a workaway on an organic farm in New Zealand.

translateBank.zh: 打工換宿讓他能旅行好幾個月卻不用花太多錢。
translateBank.en: Doing a workaway let him travel for months without spending much money.

translateBank.zh: 他第一次打工換宿是在一家民宿幫忙打掃房間。
translateBank.en: His first workaway was helping clean rooms at a guesthouse.

translateBank.zh: 我們在網路上搜尋海邊附近的打工換宿機會。
translateBank.en: We searched online for a workaway near the coast.

translateBank.zh: 打工換宿通常是用幾個小時的工作交換免費三餐和床位。
translateBank.en: A workaway usually trades a few hours of work for free food and a bed.

translateBank.zh: 他們選擇在青年旅館打工換宿，而不是住飯店。
translateBank.en: They chose a workaway at a hostel instead of staying in hotels.

translateBank.zh: 她在酒莊打工換宿，學到了很多關於葡萄酒的知識。
translateBank.en: Her workaway at the vineyard taught her a lot about wine.

translateBank.zh: 出發前，找到合適的打工換宿機會花了一些功夫研究。
translateBank.en: Finding the right workaway took some research before the trip.

translateBank.zh: 他推薦預算有限的旅客參加打工換宿計畫。
translateBank.en: He recommended a workaway program for budget travelers.

translateBank.zh: 她打工換宿期間幫忙建了一座小花園。
translateBank.en: During her workaway, she helped build a small garden.

words.zh: 沙發衝浪（借住在別人家裡）
words.ex_en: Couchsurfing let him stay with locals for free during his trip.
words.ex_zh: 沙發衝浪讓他在旅途中能免費借宿在當地人家裡。
words.ex_blank: ____ let him stay with locals for free during his trip.

translateBank.zh: 沙發衝浪讓她認識了當地人，而不是只住在飯店裡。
translateBank.en: Couchsurfing helped her meet locals instead of staying in hotels.

translateBank.zh: 他第一次嘗試沙發衝浪是在柏林。
translateBank.en: He tried couchsurfing for the first time in Berlin.

translateBank.zh: 沙發衝浪在這趟旅程中幫他們省了不少錢。
translateBank.en: Couchsurfing saved them a lot of money during the trip.

translateBank.zh: 透過沙發衝浪，我們在首爾住進了一個當地家庭。
translateBank.en: Through couchsurfing, we stayed with a family in Seoul.

translateBank.zh: 有些旅人比較喜歡沙發衝浪，因為感覺更貼近當地生活。
translateBank.en: Some travelers prefer couchsurfing because it feels more personal.

translateBank.zh: 沙發衝浪讓我們能像當地人一樣體驗這座城市。
translateBank.en: Couchsurfing let us experience the city like locals do.

translateBank.zh: 她寫了一篇部落格文章，分享她在義大利沙發衝浪的經驗。
translateBank.en: She wrote a blog post about her couchsurfing experience in Italy.

translateBank.zh: 沙發衝浪需要主人和房客之間的信任。
translateBank.en: Couchsurfing requires trust between hosts and guests.

translateBank.zh: 他的沙發衝浪房東帶他逛了附近的社區。
translateBank.en: His couchsurfing host showed him around the neighborhood.

translateBank.zh: 沙發衝浪不是每個人都適合，但對我們來說效果很好。
translateBank.en: Couchsurfing isn't for everyone, but it worked well for us.

words.ex_en: They agreed to do house-sitting for their neighbors over the summer.
words.ex_zh: 他們答應在暑假期間幫鄰居看房子。
words.ex_blank: They agreed to do ____ for their neighbors over the summer.

translateBank.zh: 他們提供免費替人看房子的服務，來換取一個落腳處。
translateBank.en: They offered free house-sitting in exchange for a place to stay.

translateBank.zh: 替人看房子讓她能在西班牙住上整整一個月。
translateBank.en: House-sitting let her live in Spain for a whole month.

translateBank.zh: 他那次看房子的工作包括照顧兩隻貓。
translateBank.en: His house-sitting job included taking care of two cats.

translateBank.zh: 我們透過一個旅遊網站找到替人看房子的機會。
translateBank.en: We found a house-sitting opportunity through a travel website.

translateBank.zh: 替人看房子是退休人士省錢旅行的熱門方式。
translateBank.en: House-sitting is a popular way for retirees to travel cheaply.

translateBank.zh: 我們在幫忙看房子的期間，每天都要幫忙澆花園。
translateBank.en: During our house-sitting stay, we watered the garden every day.

translateBank.zh: 出發前，她註冊了一個幫人看房子的網站。
translateBank.en: She signed up for a house-sitting website before her trip.

translateBank.zh: 替人看房子讓他在倫敦有了免費的住處。
translateBank.en: House-sitting gave him a free place to stay in London.

translateBank.zh: 他們看房子的任務很簡單：餵狗和檢查信箱。
translateBank.en: Their house-sitting duties were simple: feed the dog and check the mail.

translateBank.zh: 我們正在考慮用替人看房子的方式省下住宿費。
translateBank.en: We're considering house-sitting as a way to save money on accommodation.

units.title: Unit 02
units.zh: 護照到期怎麼辦？ Check Your Passport!

words.ex_en: Make sure to take your passport when you go to the airport.
words.ex_zh: 前往機場時請務必攜帶護照。
words.ex_blank: Make sure to take your ____ when you go to the airport.
words.ex2_en: She lost her passport just before the flight to Tokyo.
words.ex2_zh: 她在飛往東京的班機起飛前弄丟了護照。
words.ex2_blank: She lost her ____ just before the flight to Tokyo.
words.ex3_en: You need a valid passport to travel abroad.
words.ex3_zh: 出國旅遊需要一本有效的護照。
words.ex3_blank: You need a valid ____ to travel abroad.

translateBank.zh: 別忘了去機場時帶護照。
translateBank.en: Don't forget to bring your passport to the airport.

translateBank.zh: 她把護照放在一個防水小包裡。
translateBank.en: She keeps her passport in a waterproof pouch.

translateBank.zh: 他的護照在這趟旅程中被蓋了兩次章。
translateBank.en: His passport was stamped twice during the trip.

translateBank.zh: 入境時必須出示有效的護照。
translateBank.en: You must show a valid passport at immigration.

translateBank.zh: 訂機票前我先更新了護照。
translateBank.en: I renewed my passport before booking the flight.

translateBank.zh: 海關人員在櫃檯仔細檢查了她的護照。
translateBank.en: The officer checked her passport carefully at the counter.

translateBank.zh: 我們影印了護照，以防護照不見。
translateBank.en: We photocopied our passports in case we lost them.

translateBank.zh: 他的護照照片是三年前拍的。
translateBank.en: His passport photo was taken three years ago.

translateBank.zh: 請確認你的護照在旅程期間不會過期。
translateBank.en: Make sure your passport doesn't expire during the trip.

translateBank.zh: 航空公司不讓他在沒有護照的情況下登機。
translateBank.en: The airline wouldn't let him board without his passport.

words.ex_en: It's about time to pick my daughter up from school.
words.ex_zh: 到了該去學校接我女兒的時候了。
words.ex_blank: ____ pick my daughter up from school.
words.ex2_en: It's about time to plan our next trip.
words.ex2_zh: 該是計劃我們下一趟旅行的時候了。
words.ex2_blank: ____ plan our next trip.
words.ex3_en: It's about time to renew my passport.
words.ex3_zh: 該是更新我的護照的時候了。
words.ex3_blank: ____ renew my passport.
words.grammar: 後面接原形動詞，強調「早該做某事、現在終於要做」的語氣。

translateBank.zh: 該是打包行李準備出發的時候了。
translateBank.en: It's about time to pack for our trip.
